meta.cutoff_scope: Latest integrated source-specific component-analogue review; not a completed PA-08 search or eligible saturation refresh.

component_analogue_addendum_2026_10_01.boundary: Adult head-direction hemibrain model with fitted cell-type rate dynamics and simulation ablations. It neither studies larval nociception nor constructs a human ECAP observation operator, SCS intervention, or clinical outcome. Simulation ablations do not validate causal invariants. PA-08 saturation remains false and no NV variant is closed.

component_analogue_s900_2026_10_01.locator: bioRxiv v2 Abstract; Results > Consistency with the EPG-Delta7 connectome; Methods > Experimental procedure and Two-photon calcium imaging
component_analogue_s900_2026_10_01.boundary: Four adult Drosophila connectomes support analytical head-direction ring-attractor realizations; authors also recorded EPG jGCaMP7f activity in flies. This is a stronger fly-side structure-to-dynamics analogue than a simulation-only source, but it is not a nociception experiment, causal fly-to-human transfer, human ECAP operator, SCS intervention, or clinical outcome. It does not establish domain adaptation to ECAP or saturation of PA-08.

component_analogue_s901_2026_10_01.locator: PNAS 2022 Fig. 1C-D, Fig. 2A-B, Fig. 3, Fig. 4O and Methods larval rolling assay
component_analogue_s901_2026_10_01.boundary: The experimental paper separates acute heat nociception via peripheral C4da/TrpA1-D from injury-induced heat allodynia via central BLA/TrpA1-C in third-instar larvae. Rolling and calcium responses are fly behavioral and neural readouts; they are neither subjective pain nor a connectome-constrained dynamical model, human ECAP, SCS parameter-selection validation or clinical outcome. PA-08 remains unsaturated.

component_analogue_s902_2026_10_01.locator: Abstract > Objectives, Materials and Methods, Results
component_analogue_s902_2026_10_01.boundary: Four ECAP estimation methods were compared on 112 recordings from 14 humans using neural-response versus artifact growth-curve slopes. The accessible abstract contains no fly connectome prior, physical forward operator, patient-level pain outcome or randomized efficacy result. Full methods are paywalled; possible overlap with S787 remains unresolved. PA-08 is unsaturated.

component_analogue_s903_2026_10_01.locator: Abstract; Methods Study Design and Outcomes; Results Participant Flow and Pain Relief; Data Availability
component_analogue_s903_2026_10_01.boundary: Same NCT05177354 cohort as S826. Randomized crossover tests compare immediate in-clinic overstimulation, while 12-month VAS pain is exploratory longitudinal follow-up without a randomized long-term comparator. Individual patient datasets are not public. The paper supplies no fly model, fly-to-human ECAP mapping or validated baseline pain-outcome prediction; PA-08 remains unsaturated.

component_analogue_s905_2026_10_01.locator: Abstract; Results > A data-driven biophysically detailed neural network model; Replicating locomotion behavior
component_analogue_s905_2026_10_01.boundary: BAAIWorm couples a 136-neuron C. elegans connectome-constrained model to a simulated body and environment and tunes neural activity against an experimental 65-neuron correlation matrix. It is a partial embodied-control analogue, not Drosophila nociception, human ECAP, SCS or clinical validation. PA-08 remains unsaturated.

component_analogue_s909_2026_10_01.locator: Results > Rhythm is everywhere; Discussion > model-only limitations
component_analogue_s909_2026_10_01.boundary: Graph-null-controlled fly motor coordination is established only in simulated adult male VNC networks. The preprint does not evaluate nociception, a physical human ECAP operator or SCS outcomes. Novelty remains STOP-UNSATURATED.

component_analogue_s910_2026_10_01.boundary: Connectomic circuit context and experimental larval escape behavior are established separately from a trained connectome-dynamics model and from human ECAP/SCS. The variants remain STOP-UNSATURATED.

morphological_matrix.enumeration_policy: The Cartesian space is represented by equivalence classes after semantic and physical constraints; no surviving class is ranked.
equivalence_rules: Stimulus modalities that use the same state-transition and readout mechanism share one class.
Observation variants sharing one latent-state estimator share one class.
Larval and adult implementations remain separate when circuit topology changes the mechanism.
exclusion_rules: Exclude any chain that maps a fly signal directly to human ECAP without a physical observation model.
Exclude any chain that treats ECAP as subjective pain.
Exclude clinical-response claims without patient-linked longitudinal outcomes.
Exclude combinations lacking a falsifiable human-only and randomized-control comparison.

variants.title: Connectome-pretrained ECAP recruitment representation
variants.problem: Existing Drosophila connectome models and human SCS/ECAP models are separate; the transfer object and measurement operator are not jointly formalized.
variants.bridge: Drosophila connectome-constrained nociceptive dynamics are encoded as an abstract state; a separate physical ECAP observation model maps human neural recruitment, after which the representation is tested for the SCS task recruitment_estimation.
variants.expected_new_result: A reproducible two-model method and falsifiable experiment showing whether the Drosophila-derived constraint contributes beyond human-only and degree-preserving rewired-connectome controls with shared initialization.
variants.difference_from_analogues: Patent WO2025224687A1 already discloses simulated ECAP training data, growth-curve labeling and encoder-decoder artifact-removal pretraining. The remaining proposed distinction is the explicitly tested contribution of connectome-constrained Drosophila dynamics plus a separate physical ECAP operator; none of the cited analogues establishes that complete chain. S747 additionally couples rat neural-response classification to adaptive SCS, but has no Drosophila connectome, physical ECAP operator, held-out-animal test or human validation. S007 and S070 provide human experimental-pain cross-subject baselines, while S088 is unresolved cross-dataset prior art; none implements a Drosophila-connectome-to-physical-ECAP-to-SCS chain. S026 supports only a brain-independent fly protective-behavior observable, while S005 and S164 document heterogeneous human pain baselines and generalization gaps; none supplies an ECAP formation operator or SCS validation bridge. S148 independently requires non-interchangeable subjective, behavioral, functional and mechanistic layers, reinforcing that a fly observable or ECAP recruitment signal cannot be relabeled as subjective pain. Patent review adds ML SCS-parameter search (S098), ECAP-guided functional control (S099), federated adaptive neural interfaces (S144), population-relative multimodal control (S240), explicit body-channel/ECAP separation (S241), and a wearable multimodal stimulation loop (S245); none combines Drosophila connectome dynamics with a validated human ECAP/SCS transfer experiment. The open 2026 ModMix extension (S748) strengthens prior art for physiological-modality augmentation under limited data, but it does not provide Drosophila-derived representations, a physical ECAP operator, or an SCS task. S212 bioRxiv v3 Figure 6 already tests a larval connectome-constrained firing-rate model against observed neural-response valence and 1,000 out-degree-preserving null graphs; its fly-only task has no representation transfer, physical human ECAP operator, held-out human participant test, or SCS outcome. The Figure 6 evaluated-neuron N and train/test split remain unreported in the checked text. S855 separately tests Drosophila LIF connectome sparsification and graph-null controls in feeding/grooming circuits, without nociception or human transfer. S764 models human SCS electric fields and sensory-fiber ECAP formation via reciprocity, but has no Drosophila connectome or cross-species representation transfer; together they remain partial component analogues, not an evaluated full chain. S894 is an abstract-only Drosophila graph-fibration/LIF analogue; full text is inaccessible and no nociception or human ECAP/SCS task is established. S898 has an inspected institutional author manuscript for a larval cIVda-to-Basin-4 CaMPARI functional assay, not a dynamic whole-connectome or human stimulation model. S031 tests cold-evoked CaMPARI2/GCaMP6m activity, EM wiring, cell-type perturbation and larval contraction, but not a cross-species invariant, physical human ECAP operator or SCS task. S900 is a Drosophila head-direction ring-attractor study constrained by four connectomes and fit to in-vivo EPG calcium profiles; it supports connectome-to-activity modeling only, with no nociception, ECAP or SCS task.
required_data: human ECAP recordings with stimulation geometry
variants.falsification_experiment: On predefined subject-level splits, compare the complete model with human-only, degree-preserving rewired-connectome ensemble with shared initialization, shuffled-dynamics, and no-physical-operator controls; reject the candidate if it gives no prespecified gain or worsens calibration.
variants.permitted_conclusion: Methodological transfer for the tested ECAP/SCS task only; no claim that Drosophila experiences human pain or directly models the human spinal cord.
variants.open_condition: Scientific prior-art outcome remains partial_analogues_only. Operational STOP-UNSATURATED applies at 2026-09-26; no global no-analogue or novelty inference is permitted. Reopen under meta.operational_disposition.reopen_when.

variants.expected_new_result: A reproducible two-model method and falsifiable experiment showing whether the Drosophila-derived constraint contributes beyond human-only and degree-preserving rewired-connectome controls with shared initialization.
variants.difference_from_analogues: Patent WO2025224687A1 already discloses simulated ECAP training data, growth-curve labeling and encoder-decoder artifact-removal pretraining. The remaining proposed distinction is the explicitly tested contribution of connectome-constrained Drosophila dynamics plus a separate physical ECAP operator; none of the cited analogues establishes that complete chain. S747 additionally couples rat neural-response classification to adaptive SCS, but has no Drosophila connectome, physical ECAP operator, held-out-animal test or human validation. S007 and S070 provide human experimental-pain cross-subject baselines, while S088 is unresolved cross-dataset prior art; none implements a Drosophila-connectome-to-physical-ECAP-to-SCS chain. S026 supports only a brain-independent fly protective-behavior observable, while S005 and S164 document heterogeneous human pain baselines and generalization gaps; none supplies an ECAP formation operator or SCS validation bridge. S148 independently requires non-interchangeable subjective, behavioral, functional and mechanistic layers, reinforcing that a fly observable or ECAP recruitment signal cannot be relabeled as subjective pain. Patent review adds ML SCS-parameter search (S098), ECAP-guided functional control (S099), federated adaptive neural interfaces (S144), population-relative multimodal control (S240), explicit body-channel/ECAP separation (S241), and a wearable multimodal stimulation loop (S245); none combines Drosophila connectome dynamics with a validated human ECAP/SCS transfer experiment. The open 2026 ModMix extension (S748) strengthens prior art for physiological-modality augmentation under limited data, but it does not provide Drosophila-derived representations, a physical ECAP operator, or an SCS task. S893 applies BANC directional statistics as a weak routing prior in simulated robot control, without a nociceptive or clinical bridge. S896 maps a worm connectome to a simulated fly body; behavioral imitation is not biological fidelity or human clinical transfer. S901 supplies a larval behavioral nociception/hypersensitivity component analogue, without connectome-constrained dynamics or human transfer. S903 reports 12-month outcomes from the same Closed-Loop Australia cohort as S826; the in-clinic overstimulation comparison and secondary longitudinal pain outcomes do not test a Drosophila-to-SCS model.
required_data: human ECAP recordings with stimulation geometry
variants.falsification_experiment: On predefined subject-level splits, compare the complete model with human-only, degree-preserving rewired-connectome ensemble with shared initialization, shuffled-dynamics, and no-physical-operator controls; reject the candidate if it gives no prespecified gain or worsens calibration.
variants.permitted_conclusion: Methodological transfer for the tested ECAP/SCS task only; no claim that Drosophila experiences human pain or directly models the human spinal cord.
variants.open_condition: Scientific prior-art outcome remains partial_analogues_only. Operational STOP-UNSATURATED applies at 2026-09-26; no global no-analogue or novelty inference is permitted. Reopen under meta.operational_disposition.reopen_when.
